描述_EN: the black hawk helicopter was first introduced into military service in 1979 and is still currently in use. made from plastic, the helicopter comes with four 'power elite' action figures kitted out with weapons and military clothing. the world peacekeepers range also includes realistic military vehicles such as the a-10a thunderbolt ii plane, a humvee, an f/a-18 hornet, and many more. this toy version, made in 2012 by m&c toy centre ltd, was designed to mirror the well known piece of military hardware in order to represent modern warfare.
描述_ZN: "黑鹰 "直升机于1979年首次进入军队服役，目前仍在使用。 该直升机由塑料制成，配有四个 "权力精英 "动作人物，配备了武器和军装。 世界维和人员系列还包括逼真的军用车辆，如A-10A雷电II飞机，悍马车，F/A-18大黄蜂，以及更多。 这个玩具版本是由M&C玩具中心有限公司在2012年制作的，被设计用来反映这个著名的军事硬件，以代表现代战争。
